fusions.name: Shell-Cracking Bite
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bell-Ringer Tail
fusions.desc: Your tail sweeps every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 11 damage and stuns them for 1 second, with a 40% chance of [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Scutes
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Riveted Plating
fusions.desc: Conjures a plated hide over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
